profile.summary: A nonprofit social services and educational community organization serving American Indian youth and their families since 1974. It serves people across the greater Oakland and San Francisco Bay Area. Its programs include youth services such as an Indian Education Center, and family support services including Indian Child Welfare Act (ICWA) services.
